nodes.label: Luffy — Personal Autonomous Crypto-Trading OS
nodes.rationale: Not a signal bot but a closed-loop trading organism: observe → decide → act → record → learn → explain. Named after the owner's idea; lives on the owner's laptop VM.

nodes.label: Strategy Genome System
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis must cite its inefficiency — vague hypotheses are rejected — and an invalidation (falsification clause) is required, so a genome cannot be proposed without a testable claim.

nodes.label: Risk Envelope (moderate, amended for correlation reality)
nodes.rationale: Costs are modelled from day one (taker fees + ATR-scaled slippage + perp funding in all P&L math).

nodes.label: Journal (SQLite/WAL)
nodes.rationale: Rejected setups are tracked with identical rigor to executed ones, so 100% decision-journal coverage includes skipped setups and the owner can interrogate any decision.

nodes.label: ACTIVE / FROZEN / HALTED Control State Machine
nodes.rationale: FROZEN blocks new entries but manages existing positions to natural close; HALTED stops brain loops and leaves exits manual-only, while exchange-native stops stay armed in every state.
